title: Unit 6: Viet Nam: Then and Now

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Life in the Subsidised Period vs Digital Age
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Life in the Subsidised Period vs Digital Age.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.term: Past Perfect Tense (Quá khứ hoàn thành)
concepts.definition: Had + Past Participle (V3/-ed). Used to describe an action that happened before another past action or before a specific past point in time.
concepts.example: By the time the high-speed railway was opened in 2021, citizens had waited for several years.
concepts.essence: Establishes clear chronological order between two past events: action 1 (Past Perfect), action 2 (Past Simple).

concepts.definition: The historical era in Vietnam (1976-1986) before Doi Moi, characterized by food stamps, bicycles, and rationing coupons.
concepts.example: Before the Doi Moi reforms in 1986, people had bought goods using ration stamps.
concepts.essence: Cultural background knowledge frequently integrated into reading comprehension texts.

rules.statement: Time conjunctions with Past Perfect: Before, After, By the time
rules.meaning: Before / By the time + Past Simple, Past Perfect. After + Past Perfect, Past Simple.
rules.example: After they had completed the survey, they submitted the report to the municipal authorities.
rules.essence: Action happening first takes 'had + P2'; action happening later takes Past Simple.

workedExamples.prompt: Combine the two sentences using 'before': 'The fire brigade arrived. The historic wooden house burned down.'
steps: Bước 1: Xác định hành động xảy ra trước: ngôi nhà bị cháy rụi (hành động 1). Cứu hỏa đến sau (hành động 2).
Bước 2: Hành động 1 chia ở Past Perfect: 'had burned down'.
Bước 3: Hành động 2 chia ở Past Simple: 'arrived'.
Bước 4: Nối câu: 'The historic wooden house had burned down before the fire brigade arrived.'
workedExamples.answer: The historic wooden house had burned down before the fire brigade arrived.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing which action happened first, leading to inverted tenses in the sentence.
commonMistakes.why: Always sketch a mental timeline: the event that occurred earlier in the past must take 'had + P2'.
